carries.from: the pull request fixing D2-01 (#1450), which removed nine max(<capacity>, 0.01) divisors and the DHW guard from thermal_model.py but left the one in optimizer.py:_dhw_coil_wood_forecast
carries.control: D2-01's own measurement: the two-zone tank rate used max(C_buf, 0.01) while the same step used the raw C_buf, so the floor diverges the divisor from the value. The thermal_model.py fix removed those floors and added seven arms in tests/features.py. optimizer.py:_dhw_coil_wood_forecast is the same class — a wood capacity floored by max(..., 0.01) — and is the one remaining site after #1450; the perturbing arm that would falsify it is deleting the max(...) wrapper and confirming the wood capacity flows through raw.
carries.remeasure: At your own merge base, from the repository root: `grep -rn 'max(.*0.01)' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py` names _dhw_coil_wood_forecast's floor as the survivor; the D2-01 fix's tests/features.py arms are the instrument for the thermal_model.py sites. Do not trust the line number 4441 across the optimizer PR #1486 (it inserts a bang-bang start and shifts lines) — name the symbol.
carries.brief: One line to repair: drop the max(p.wood_tank_thermal_mass, 0.01) floor in _dhw_coil_wood_forecast, matching the D2-01 treatment. Same gate scope as D2-01. The name _dhw_coil_wood_forecast, not the line number, is the identifier that survives the optimizer PR's line shift.
